system.summary: Unknown. Censorship found coded passages in POW mail; NR 2892 describes the system. It may be an open code or letter-position scheme in German text rather than a classical cipher.

prior_solution.where: NR 2892 (Apr 1945) describes the system; not seen. No published reading found.

conditions.human_role: Selected the target and asked for the folder to be created.

solution.what: Checked whether either NARA file is digitised: catalog entries naId 2809479 and 7523906 are paper only, no images.

Two web searches on the NR 2892 title and on coded German POW letters in US camps. No printed or online reading or description of the system found; results were British/WWI POW stories (Pryor, Alldritt) and a Schmeh blog post. Shallow: cryptiana pages not checked.

outcome.method_basis: Not attempted: no ciphertext and no description of the system is available; both files are undigitised.
outcome.notes: Blocked on access: order or photograph NR 2892 and CNSG 3460/2 at NARA College Park, then test the messages against the system NR 2892 describes.
